XPay / Documentation

Whitepaper

The product thesis, architecture direction, and principles behind a simpler crypto payment experience.

Abstract Thesis Product Payments Swap $XPAY Campaign Security Roadmap
· October 2026

Abstract

XPay is building a simpler interface for everyday crypto actions. The core idea is straightforward: people should be able to pay another person by a human-readable username, exchange assets through a clear swap flow, and understand every action before it is confirmed.

The product is intentionally focused. Instead of turning the first experience into a trading terminal or a complex wallet dashboard, XPay centers the experience around identity, intent, confirmation and a small number of useful actions.

01 / Thesis

Crypto should feel understandable.

Wallet addresses, networks, signatures and transaction states are powerful primitives, but they are not the language most people want to use every day.

Human layer

Pay by identity

Use a username as the starting point for a payment instead of making a long address the center of the experience.

Action layer

Make intent obvious

Keep the amount, asset, recipient, quote and final action visible at the moment a user needs to decide.

02 / Product

One product. Two core actions.

XPay is organized around Pay and Swap. Wallet, activity and the welcome campaign support those actions without competing with them.

01

Pay by Username

Send supported assets to a resolved XPay username with a recipient-first confirmation flow.

02

Swap with X

Exchange supported assets through a quote, review and confirmation experience centered on X.

03 / Payments

Pay by Username

A username is the human-readable destination. The system is designed to resolve that identity before the user commits to the transfer.

01Enter the username
02Resolve and verify the recipient
03Choose asset and amount
04Review network and payment details
05Confirm the transfer
Design principle
The recipient should never be ambiguous at the point of confirmation.
04 / Exchange

Swap

The swap experience reduces a complex routing process into a clear user decision: what goes in, what comes out, what it costs, and what happens next.

Quote

Present the expected output and relevant fee information before confirmation.

Execution

Production infrastructure can connect routing, liquidity, transaction signing and settlement behind the same interface.

05 / X Token

$XPAY — XPay's core asset.

$XPAY is the core XPay ecosystem asset, with the initial exchange experience centered on X and the token being brought to Robinhood Chain.

Network

Robinhood Chain

Built for an EVM-compatible Layer-2 environment, with $XPAY positioned as the XPay ecosystem token on the network.

Simple access

Keep the primary swap path centered on X rather than overwhelming users with unnecessary asset choices.

Ecosystem utility

Expand the role of X through useful product experiences as the underlying infrastructure matures.

06 / Growth

Welcome Campaign

The campaign is designed to introduce users to the XPay ecosystem through clear onboarding actions. Eligible rewards are tracked in the user's XPay balance and become available according to the campaign's verification and eligibility rules.

01Discover XPay
02Complete eligible actions
03Receive the unlocked reward balance
04Claim when available
07 / Security

Trust is part of the interface.

Security is built into the experience. Clear, deliberate steps help users understand every important action with confidence.

Identity visibility

Show the resolved recipient and relevant account context before payment confirmation.

Explicit review

Separate intent, review and confirmation so users have a final opportunity to catch mistakes.

Transaction history

Give users a clear record of payments, swaps and reward activity.

Production controls

Use secure authentication, audited contracts, transaction monitoring, safety controls and reliable infrastructure as the product moves toward production.

08 / Roadmap

From product experience to production network.

01
Product foundation

Refine Pay, Swap, Wallet, Activity and campaign experiences.

02
Identity & accounts

Connect authentication, secure profiles and username resolution.

03
Onchain execution

Connect wallet infrastructure, RPC services, transaction signing and settlement.

04
Robinhood Chain / $XPAY

Connect the finalized $XPAY deployment, RPC infrastructure, transaction signing and settlement on Robinhood Chain.

05
Swap infrastructure

Connect routing, liquidity, pricing, slippage and transaction execution.

06
Scale & security

Introduce monitoring, audits, safety controls, reliability and production operations.

XPay / About

About XPay

A crypto payment experience built around people, not wallet addresses.

The idea

Pay. Swap. Simple.

XPay is focused on making everyday crypto interactions feel closer to the products people already understand.

The starting point is simple: send value to a username, swap with X, and keep the experience clean enough that users always know what they are doing.

01 / Identity

Names over long addresses.

XPay puts a human-readable username at the center of payments while keeping the underlying wallet infrastructure behind the experience.

02 / Simplicity

Less interface. More clarity.

Every screen is designed around one primary decision, with confirmation and transaction context shown when it matters.

03 / X

A focused $XPAY experience.

$XPAY is the central XPay asset, giving the product a clear identity while keeping the first swap experience focused.

04 / Ecosystem

Built to expand carefully.

The foundation can grow into richer wallet, payment, identity and onchain experiences without losing the simplicity of the core product.

Product principles
01Make the user's intent obvious.
02Show the important details before confirmation.
03Keep the core flows fast and focused.
04Build infrastructure that can scale behind a simple interface.
The vision

Make onchain feel everyday.

XPay is being shaped as a simple front door to crypto payments and asset exchange — familiar enough for a first-time user, powerful enough to grow with the ecosystem.
